artifact.title: Hiring trends in India

279a8b3c-9a09-539b-a8b0-12df9afd08eb.content_text: Hiring trends in India, 2026 edition. The survey covered 4,200 employers across 12 sectors. Median time to hire fell to 31 days, down from 38 days a year earlier. 27% of employers said they now use structured interviews for every role. Remote roles made up 18 roles of postings. Employers reported 2.3 million open roles nationally.
